name: Toggle
description: A switch for settings that take effect immediately: a native checkbox with role=switch in Checkbox's field anatomy.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether it's on. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model:checked. Emitted as data-state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled toggle.

props.name: color
props.description: The track color when on. Emitted as data-color.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the control. Name the setting, not the state.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the label, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks it invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks it invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { track: '…', label: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The track, label, description and error.

parts.name: track
parts.description: The pill. The native control covers it.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native checkbox with role=switch, transparent over the track with a 6px larger hit area. Attributes other than class land here.

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: The knob; it moves to the end when on.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the control.

events.name: checked-change
events.description: The toggle turned on or off.

requirements: A native input type=checkbox with role=switch stays in the DOM over the track, so the platform handles keyboard and screen readers.
The label is linked with for/id; description and error with aria-describedby.
Off keeps a 3:1 outline (--apui-border-default) so the control is visible without color; on fills with the color.
The thumb moves toward the logical end, so it mirrors under RTL.
Thumb motion is removed under prefers-reduced-motion.
Disabled uses --apui-surface-sunken and --apui-text-disabled, never opacity alone.
Visible focus ring on the track while the control has :focus-visible.
Use Checkbox, not Toggle, in forms that need a submit.

parts.description: Follows your system setting when off.
parts.error: Ask your admin to turn this on.
